'''Rory''' (Japanese: '''ミキオ''' ''Mikio'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP188|Spring Fever]]''. He is a professional {{wp|hot spring}} digger who travels around the world with his daughter, [[Peggy]], digging hot springs. Large hotels hire him to dig these hot springs in order to build large resorts.
{{-}}
